name: Telangana

topAttractions.name: Charminar
topAttractions.description: A historic mosque and one of the most iconic landmarks in India, built in 1591 by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah.

topAttractions.name: Golconda Fort
topAttractions.description: A 16th-century fort and former capital of the Qutb Shahi dynasty, known for its impressive architecture and acoustics.

topAttractions.name: Warangal Fort
topAttractions.description: A 13th-century fort built by the Kakatiya dynasty, featuring intricate stone carvings and a grand history.

bestTimeToVisit: October to February, when the weather is mild and pleasant.
culturalFact: Telangana is home to the traditional art of Kondapalli toy making, a GI-tagged craft that involves creating intricate wooden toys and figurines.

hiddenGem.name: Khammam's Kinnerasani Wildlife Sanctuary
hiddenGem.description: A lesser-known wildlife sanctuary that offers trekking and birdwatching opportunities amidst lush forests and waterfalls.

relatedFestival: Bathukamma, a vibrant festival celebrated by Telangana women to honor the goddess Lakshmi and the arrival of spring.
passportTieIn: If you've already visited the Golconda Fort in Hyderabad, you might be interested in exploring the similar architecture and history of the Warangal Fort in Telangana.
